content: Ginyir van tidi duw Pol diki maaj di wukidil.
Pistas a tamiyaar yakuw, nyi mugwul yidaak, Sisariya wapakuw, di Jiruwsalimaar ata yad.

Alim sapakwa nyanugwa pris awa Juw dayadiy sapakwa nyanugw maaj wadaad dikik Polak. Day Pistasak bas sidika sidaad di daya mawula pik tikuw, Polaam wayakik yidikikik Jiruwsalimaar. Aw day maaj bwu lakatiydaal day Polaam viyasipak nyidi yabim. Alik day atawa wadiy.
Pistas ata wadidiy, “Pol kalabus im rinaad Sisariyaam. Kwasa kwakuw, wun alir yikidiwun.
“Li wadi duw kupwaraap kwurdik, gwuradiy sapakwa nyanugw Sisariyaar yikwadiy. Alim day maaj wakwadadiwun dikik.”
Pistas nuwukadiy nyi abamugwul tabatiy kaam dayawa kwakuw, Sisariyaar ata sibinin yad. Sira pik kotiy kil wiyaam daan rikuw, di maaj wayakidil Polaam kwurin kariyadakik.
Pol yakuw, adiy Jiruwsalim tipa kidiy Juw day dim kaypwusin kwurin tikuw, maaj samasam Pistasak wadiy Polak. Day adiy maaj dayadiy maaw maa rav simaka simakak.
Pol di dayak ata wadidiy, “Juw dayadiy lo, God dikidi wiy dikidiy lo, Rom dayadi yitaypika duw dikidiy lo, adiy lo abab wun dayaam maa sar.”
Pol ata waad, “Wun Siysak yikir.”
Pistas sukwasukw kwurik adiy Juwak. Alik di Polak bas sidid, “Min Jiruwsalimaar yikir alim mina kot wukituwkik?”
Pol ata wadid, “Kilim Siysa diki kot im tinadiwun. Kilim min wunaam kotiy kimina. Min bwu lakwumina wun jaal maa di adiy Juwak.

“Aw li wun gwuradiy lo wak maa sartuw, aw min kiyakwaad wakimina a javik, aal yaakiya, wun maaj maa. Wunaam viyasipa-kigwuradiwun. Aw li daya maaj wunak suwaal tikila, duw nak wunaam, dayadiy tabaam takatak maa rav. Gwuradi Roma yitaypika duw Siysa dayadiy wunaam parsakiy maaj wukikida.”
Pistas maaj bwulakuw dikidiy lakwudiy duwawa, Polak ata wadid, “Min nyanadi yitaypika duwak yikir. Yaakiya, dikik yikimina.”
Pistas Agripak wadid Polak.
Nuwukadiy nyi yidaak, walibab ril tamiy dayadi yitaypika duw, Agripa, diki jikwaar Binaysiy, liwa yad wayapiy sikir Pistasak.
Alim nuwukadiy nyi kwakuw, Pistas Agripak yarik yidid Polak. “Piylik yidik, kalabus im rinadi duw nak wapadid wunak.
“Wun Jiruwsalimaar yikuw, adiy Juw dayadiy yitaypika pris awa sapakwa nyanugw maaj wadadiwun dikik. Dayadiy mawul wadiy wun watuw, kiyadikik.
“Aw wun dayak ata watuwdiy, ‘Nyan Rom tipa kidiy duw akis kip tin duw kwiy-kwanadiyan adiy parsakiy maaj wadiy duwak. Taay di rapin tikuw, wakwaad daya majik dikik.’
“Day abab kilir yadaak, wun kavin maa kwu. Sira pik wun kot a wiyaam daan rikuw, wun maaj wayakituwil adi duwak.
“Wuna mawul waal day mwiya kupwarapa valik kotiy daad. Aw atawa maa.
“Day diwa maaj warjuwdiy ata ata day gaba maaj sukwudiy dayadi Godak. Niki jaav, day wadiy duw nak Jisas, di bwu kiyaad. Aw Pol di waad adi Jisas kip kwanaad.
“Wun mwiyir maa laakw ata ata kidiy jaav dayadiy maaw wuki-kituwadiy. Alik wun Polak bas situwid di yaakiya wakida Jiruwsalimaar yikuw, alim di kot wukikituwa.
“Aw Pol maa wakuw, di waad di Siysak yikir. Wakuw, wun watuwid Siysa di diki kot wukikida. Aw taay di kalabus im kwakwaad.”
Agripa Pistasak ata wadid, “Wunabab kidi duw diki maaj wukik.” Wakuw, Pistas wadid, “Yaakiya, sir wukikimina.”
Agripawa Binaysiy gilabadiy sawkuw, kot a wiyaar wulabir.

Sira pik Agripawa Binaysiy kot a wiyaar wulabir. Day gilabadiy kwurin ababa vay sawdiy duw dayadiy sapakwa nyanugwawa a tipa kidiy sapakwa nyanugw bapaam tikuw, birakiwa wuladiy. Wulakuw, Pistas wadik, day Pol kwurin kariyadaad dayak.

Pistas di ata waad, “Yitaypika duw Agripawa abab kilim vagaluwdiy duw taakw, kidi duw vigwuraad. Adiy kilim kwanadiywa Jiruwsalimaam kwanadiy Juw day maaj wadadiwun dikik. Day gaam sidiy di kiyadikik.
“Aw wun daya maaj wukikuw, wun maa sitakir jaav nak a javik nyan dim viyasipa-kibanaad. Di, ‘Wun Siysak yikir,’ wakuw, wun yaakiya wadiwun diki majik.

“Aw wun maa laakw agwa maaj wun sukwukituwa Siysak. Alik nibwul wun kidi duw kwurin kariya-tuwaad minak, yitaypika duw Agripa, gwurawa nakab. Aw nyan diki maaj wukikuw, wun agwa maaja lakwu-kituwa lapa nyigaam sukwu-tuwkik nyanadi yitaypika duw Siysak.
“Aw li wun kalabus im rinadi duw kip wayakituwaad dikik, aal kupwaraapa.”
